name: ba-kit
description: PeoplesHR tooling for Business Analysts. Ships the phx-write-frd skill for authoring the Feature Requirements Document (FRD) against the template held in the PHR-X project wiki. phx-write-frd needs a per-developer Azure DevOps MCP server, which this plugin does not ship. The weknora MCP server declaration was removed in 3.0.0; product knowledge comes from phx-product-context in org-standards.
